mandatoryCriteria: CRD-01: Member/manager/owner creates title in an active authorized column; required field and retry failures retain draft and create once.
CRD-02: Show title, priority, due date, assignees and accurate comment/image counts without loading full descriptions/history.
CRD-03: Card link loads an authorized popup/drawer or direct-page view with focus restoration and recoverable missing/loading states.
CRD-04: Explicit Save validates plain text and expected card version; Cancel/discard never overwrites saved state.
CRD-05: Five priority values and optional date-only deadline save/reset consistently; invalid calendar dates fail and overdue excludes done cards.
CRD-06: Assign zero/multiple active eligible project users or owner; removed identities stay labeled historical and cannot be newly assigned.
CRD-07: Server validates neighbors and versions, changes rank/history atomically and returns canonical position; failure restores server order.
CRD-08: Visible Move chooses column plus first/last/before/after via bounded placement read; equivalent outcome without dragging.
CRD-09: Explain disabled ambiguous drag while filters apply; Move uses full destination order rather than renumbering visible cards only.
CRD-10: Stale field/order version returns 409 without partial side effects; preserve draft and allow deliberate refresh/reapply.
CRD-11: Save affects fields only; comment/upload actions are independent; retries keep command identity and closing protects unsaved work.
CRD-12: Undo is a new authorized versioned move; it succeeds once or explains conflict without overwriting intervening work.
COM-01: Project readers see chronological comments with author displays; stable cursors do not expose other project content.
COM-02: Member/manager/owner posts plain text independently of card Save; atomic event/outbox/receipt and lost-response retry create one comment.
COM-03: Accessible picker resolves active project identities; validated UTF-16 spans produce mentions and literal at-name text does not notify.
COM-04: Author updates with expected version; edit activity persists and v1 edits do not resend mention notifications.
COM-05: Author or owner/manager tombstones a comment, records action and hides body from normal reads; other members cannot moderate.
COM-06: Typing, mention selection and post error survive field saves/refetch; no comment posts accidentally through Enter in a picker.

Mounted operations enforce current identity, role/target authority, project and board grants, resource ancestry, lifecycle and receipt replay boundaries; negative cases cannot expose data or write effects.
Applicable writes preserve state/version, minimal receipt, activity and outbox atomically; real separate-connection tests cover the feature races and retention limits.

Every listed backend feature requires a fresh independent review of its complete reachable frozen source, fixed weights/category minima, unrounded score strictly greater than8.5, no blocker and actual passing checks. Builders cannot approve their own work.

Required UI and integration phases need actual test/browser evidence with current backend/UI hash bindings; source or API tests alone cannot prove UI or real-provider/hosted acceptance. Do not relabel missing mandatory behavior deferred to close a feature.
scopeAndExclusions: Current listed product features and reachable shared dependencies; PostgreSQL Node/Worker and Next static UI. Review alone does not approve unexecuted UI/hosted/provider/deployment behavior. Real OAuth must not be replaced with an email-only session. Direct UAT after all local gates pass; hosted checks remain UAT pending until run. No dev/production. Reconciled retirements preserve stableIDs and precede scoring. No real credentials or live-user data in tests/logs.
releaseSequenceClarification: User explicitly clarified2026-11-03: all local gates pass and source freezes, deploy UAT directly, then finish hosted checks. Host-dependent checks remain UAT pending and are not falsely closed. No dev or production.

requiredTestsExpansion.reason: Before final review/source freeze, explicitly require existing generated-contract parity, embedded-SQL parity and actual local browser/MCP integration commands. This adds checks without changing or weakening any acceptance statement or score threshold.
requiredTestsExpansion.runnerEnvironment: Runner must supply explicit disposable loopback PostgreSQL test URLs, NODE_ENV=test and the documented local browser executable/runtime; commands do not use production or hosted user data.
